enrichment.hook: An expansion to San Francisco by the UK’s first certified Regenified coffee roaster.
enrichment.description: Routes Coffee LLC has filed a business permit for a location on 12th Avenue following recent pop-up appearances in the city. The operation brings sustainably sourced specialty beans and global roasting expertise to the local coffee scene.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted newcomer preparing to make its debut in Lower Pacific Heights.
enrichment.description: Oddjoy is currently moving through the early establishment stages following its business registration filing. Build-out and preparation are underway at its Pine Street location.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing Chinatown staple on Grant Ave specializing in traditional Chinese apparel and custom qipaos.
enrichment.description: Mei Mei Fashion is a well-known neighborhood boutique in San Francisco's Chinatown offering traditional Chinese clothing, formal wear, and custom garments like wedding qipaos. Though newly registered under an LLC structure recently, the storefront has been a familiar fixture serving local and visiting shoppers for years.

enrichment.hook: An upcoming French-owned patisserie expanding its production presence to the Bayview district.
enrichment.description: Le Carousel Patisserie is expanding its operations into a commissary space on Revere Avenue following its previous pop-ups and delivery setups. The French-owned bakery specializes in classic, beautifully crafted traditional French desserts and viennoiserie.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted hospitality venture taking shape in San Francisco's Marina district.
enrichment.description: Jeong Hospitality is a newly registered business entity in San Francisco currently undergoing initial setup and pre-opening phases following its recent permit filing.

enrichment.hook: Quirky, artist-made accessories brand prepping a new workspace or location.
enrichment.description: Jenny Lemons is a well-known San Francisco creative lifestyle and accessories brand founded by Jennie Lennick. Following the closure of its prior Mission District storefront, a new business permit was filed at a residential/studio address on Lisbon Street.

enrichment.hook: An upcoming spot bringing traditional Indian flavors to the Inner Richmond.
enrichment.description: India Gourmet is currently undergoing early preparations and build-out following its recent business permit filing on Clement Street.

enrichment.hook: Acclaimed East Bay specialty roaster expanding into San Francisco's SoMa neighborhood.
enrichment.description: Highwire Coffee Roasters is bringing its popular small-batch coffee, seasonal teas, and pastries to 555 Bryant Street following a business permit filed in July 2026. The incoming SoMa café will mark a notable SF expansion for the regional favorite known for its approachably balanced brews.

enrichment.hook: A new neighborhood bodega and convenience shop slated for Chinatown's historic Grant Avenue.
enrichment.description: Hello Convenience LLC recently filed its business registration for 1126 Grant Ave in San Francisco. The shop is currently undergoing initial preparation and has not yet officially opened its doors to the public.

enrichment.hook: A neighborhood fixture on Ocean Avenue serving up comforting Cantonese classics and dim sum.
enrichment.description: Golden Coast Restaurant is a casual dining destination in the Oceanview neighborhood offering a robust selection of traditional dim sum, Cantonese seafood, and hot pot dishes.

places.dba_name: Gainz And Shreds Meal Prep San Francisco

enrichment.hook: A popular Bay Area macro-friendly, halal meal prep service expanding to San Francisco.
enrichment.description: Gainz and Shreds Meal Prep is bringing its high-protein custom meal plans, bulk options, and diverse fitness-focused menu to San Francisco with a new Lower Mission location.

enrichment.hook: A daytime coffee and breakfast spot from Sausalito's Franko & Co. that transforms into a cozy wine bar at night.
enrichment.description: Brought to Union Street by the team behind Sausalito's Franko & Co., this Ukrainian-owned concept plans to serve coffee, pastries, and brunch items by day before shifting to a wine and sparkling wine bar in the evenings.

enrichment.hook: A newly permitted storefront on Powell Street in Chinatown.
enrichment.description: A business permit was recently filed for Duo Duo at 1224 Powell Street, though it is still early in development with no official public opening date announced yet.

enrichment.hook: A long-standing Inner Sunset neighborhood fixture known for classic, fluffy donuts and late-night hours.
enrichment.description: Donut World is a beloved, no-frills local bakery on 9th Avenue serving an extensive array of fresh traditional donuts, fritters, and pastries. It has operated as a staple of the neighborhood for years.
